#### 1. medulloblastoma  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.781)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:2514)

**Proposed mechanism:** CTNNB1 (HGNC:2514) —INCREASES→ Wnt signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-2550049); Wnt signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-2550049) —LEADS_TO→ Medulloblastoma (MONDO:0007959); Wnt signaling pathway (REACT:R-HSA-2550049) —LEADS_TO→ Desmoplastic/nodular medulloblastoma (HP:0030055); CTNNB1 (HGNC:2514) —INCREASES→ Increased proliferation of neuronal progenitor cells (HP:0002458). Gain-of-function mutations in CTNNB1 lead to aberrant activation of the Wnt signaling pathway, which is a known driver of medulloblastoma development and also contributes to increased proliferation of neuronal progenitor cells, a phenotype observed in related conditions.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic loss-of-function variants in CTNNB1 associated with either disease, or variants with significantly different functional consequences on Wnt signaling activation. _(variant: rs28929617)_

**Why it matters:** Targeting the aberrant Wnt signaling pathway activated by CTNNB1 mutations could offer therapeutic strategies for both medulloblastoma and other conditions driven by this oncogene.
